shapeSummary: Clevis-style stamped bracket: a flat 3 mm foot plate with one 8 mm through hole, two parallel 3 mm side flanges with a sloped profile rising to the pin end, and a 12.6 mm cross pin spanning the flanges along X. Overall about 34 x 50 x 30 mm.
warnings: Only the 12.6 mm pin diameter is stated; all other dimensions are estimated from image proportions.
The pin is modeled as a solid cylinder through the flanges, so no separate pin hole is cut.
The sloped web and its second hole are omitted because their size and axis are unclear. The foot plate is modeled flat.
The axis convention follows the supplied bounds (X is the pin axis, Y is 50 mm long, Z is 30 mm). The bottom is at Y=0, and X and Z are centered.
The foot hole diameter (8 mm) and position are guesses.
Sheet thickness and bend radii are assumed, with sharp corners.
